headline_marked: [[Philips 55-inch 4K QLED TV]] with 144Hz refresh rate drops to $248
headline: Philips 55-inch 4K QLED TV with 144Hz refresh rate drops to $248
summary: This Philips Google TV boasts a 4K QLED panel and a 144Hz refresh rate, perfect for gaming and sports, now at an unprecedented price.
details: Tech products are generally becoming more expensive, but TVs are a notable exception, offering better specs at lower prices over time. The Philips 55-inch 4K QLED Google TV with a 144Hz refresh rate is currently on sale for an incredible $248.

This Philips model features a 4K QLED panel for vibrant colors and deep contrast. Gamers and sports enthusiasts will appreciate the smooth motion provided by its 144Hz refresh rate. It also supports HDR10 and AMD FreeSync Premium technology to eliminate screen tearing.

The TV runs on Google TV, offering a user-friendly interface and easy access to a wide range of streaming services. While some users may find the ads on the Google TV home screen intrusive, alternative launchers like Projectivity Launcher can provide a cleaner, ad-free experience.

With solid reviews from Walmart customers, this Philips TV offers exceptional value for its price point. It may not be the absolute best TV on the market, but for $248, its combination of QLED, 144Hz, and Google TV makes it a highly attractive option.
